responsibility: Declares the ASTValidation pass that performs contextual front-end validation directly on Rust AST nodes. It exposes a check(AST::Crate&) entry point and the specialized visitor hooks for modules, constants, lifetimes, loop labels, unions, functions, and traits, defining the public interface for the early structural/semantic validation pass whose implementation emits diagnostics for invalid source constructs.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ASTValidation visitor class and its check(AST::Crate&) entry point for the errors layer; unlike the companion .cc, it only defines the pass interface and overridable visit methods, not the specific validation diagnostics.
